results.verdict: TARGET-CONDITIONING STEERS, WITH A SAFETY TRADE-OFF (positive but honest): the validated HIV QSAR (scaffold AUROC 0.806) DOES steer generation toward the target — mean predicted P(HIV-active) 0.1636 = 3.96× the unconditioned GA (0.0413) and 1.81× the seeds (0.0906) — and preserves drug-likeness (QED 0.7714) and synthesizability (SA 2.2654) at validity 1.0, novelty 1.0. BUT predicted SAFETY drops (0.4336 conditioned vs 0.8042 unconditioned): HIV-active-like chemistry is predicted more toxic — a genuine activity-vs-safety trade-off, honestly surfaced (the objective could be re-weighted toward safety). HONEST SCOPE: activity is QSAR-PREDICTED not measured; optimizing vs a QSAR invites gaming (63% of candidates in ADMET domain); candidates are hypotheses, NOT validated actives/drugs.
